title: BayCom Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: BayCom Corp filed a Form 8-K on April 7, 2026 announcing a leadership transition in which the Board terminated its CEO, COO, and CFO without cause and appointed new executives including a new CEO, CFO, and Executive Vice Chair. The departures involve aggregate cash severance of approximately $6.8 million plus benefits.
key_points: On April 7, 2026, BayCom Corp's Board approved termination without cause of CEO George J. Guarini, COO Janet L. King, and CFO (name not stated in excerpt)
New leadership appointments include an Executive Vice Chair, new CEO, and new CFO
CEO severance: $4,404,174 cash payment over 24 months plus 22,109 shares accelerated vesting
COO severance: $2,413,017 cash payment over 12 months
Guarini will remain as non-executive employee through July 6, 2026 and continue as Bank board member
BayCom Corp trades as BCML on Nasdaq; wholly owns United Business Bank
